name: Global Energy Equation Disguise
description: Replaces the local matrix determinant constraint with a mathematically equivalent global equation ($E = m + 3K$). Models that mechanically translate the problem into code without algebraic simplification will implement this as a global check at the end of their DFS, leading to an immediate Time Limit Exceeded on $3^{40}$ states. Models that genuinely reason mathematically will simplify the equation to $E_0 = 0$ (meaning $p_u \neq p_v$ for all edges) and recover the local pruning required to solve it efficiently.
